namespace @NAMESPACE@;

internal static class EventData
{
    internal static readonly Dictionary<string, JsonElement> Rows = Load();
    private static Dictionary<string, JsonElement> Load()
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(@EVENTS_JSON@);
        return doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray().ToDictionary(r => r.GetProperty("id").GetString()!, r => r.Clone());
    }
}

public abstract class AuthoredEvent : CustomEventModel
{
    protected AuthoredEvent() : base(true) { }
    private JsonElement Row => EventData.Rows[GetType().Name[6..]];
    private bool Resolved;
    public override bool IsShared => false;
    public override ActModel[] Acts => ModelDb.ActsByIndex
        .Where((_, index) => Row.GetProperty("acts").EnumerateArray().Any(a => a.GetInt32() == index + 1))
        .SelectMany(variants => variants).ToArray();
    public override bool IsAllowed(IRunState runState) => runState.Players.Count() == 1
        && runState.Players.Single().Character is Character;
    // Explicit native runtime artwork; no game imagery is included in the package.
    private static string FallbackId => ModelDb.Event<TabletOfTruth>().Id.Entry.ToLowerInvariant();
    public override string CustomInitialPortraitPath => ImageHelper.GetImagePath("events/" + FallbackId + ".png");
    public override string CustomBackgroundScenePath => SceneHelper.GetScenePath("events/background_scenes/" + FallbackId);
    public override string CustomVfxPath => SceneHelper.GetScenePath("vfx/events/" + FallbackId + "_vfx");
    private static string Rules(JsonElement choice)
    {
        var cost = choice.GetProperty("cost"); var reward = choice.GetProperty("reward");
        return string.Join(" NL ", new[] {
            cost.GetProperty("gold").GetInt32() is > 0 and var goldCost ? $"Pay {goldCost} Gold." : null,
            cost.GetProperty("hp").GetInt32() is > 0 and var hpCost ? $"Lose {hpCost} HP (must leave at least 1 HP)." : null,
            reward.GetProperty("gold").GetInt32() is > 0 and var gold ? $"Gain {gold} Gold." : null,
            reward.GetProperty("heal").GetInt32() is > 0 and var heal ? $"Heal {heal} HP." : null
        }.Where(s => s != null));
    }
    public override List<(string,string)> Localization
    {
        get {
            var lines = new List<(string,string)> {
                ("title", Row.GetProperty("name").GetString()!), ("pages.INITIAL.description", Row.GetProperty("body").GetString()!),
                ("pages.INITIAL.options.Leave.title", "Leave"), ("pages.INITIAL.options.Leave.description", "Continue your journey."),
                ("pages.LEFT.description", "You continue on your way.")
            };
            foreach (var choice in Row.GetProperty("choices").EnumerateArray()) {
                var id = choice.GetProperty("id").GetString();
                lines.Add(($"pages.INITIAL.options.{id}.title", choice.GetProperty("name").GetString()!));
                lines.Add(($"pages.INITIAL.options.{id}.description", Rules(choice)));
                lines.Add(($"pages.RESULT_{id}.description", choice.GetProperty("result").GetString()!));
            }
            return lines;
        }
    }
    private bool CanAfford(JsonElement choice) => Owner != null && Owner.Gold >= choice.GetProperty("cost").GetProperty("gold").GetInt32()
        && Owner.Creature.CurrentHp > choice.GetProperty("cost").GetProperty("hp").GetInt32();
    protected override IReadOnlyList<EventOption> GenerateInitialOptions()
    {
        var options = new List<EventOption>();
        foreach (var choice in Row.GetProperty("choices").EnumerateArray()) {
            var captured = choice;
            var option = new EventOption(this, CanAfford(choice) ? () => Resolve(captured) : null,
                $"{Id.Entry}.pages.INITIAL.options.{choice.GetProperty("id").GetString()}");
            if (choice.GetProperty("cost").GetProperty("hp").GetInt32() is > 0 and var hp) option.ThatDoesDamage(hp);
            options.Add(option);
        }
        options.Add(new EventOption(this, Leave, $"{Id.Entry}.pages.INITIAL.options.Leave"));
        return options;
    }
    private Task Leave()
    {
        if (!Resolved) { Resolved = true; SetEventFinished(PageDescription("LEFT")); }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
    private async Task Resolve(JsonElement choice)
    {
        if (Resolved) return;
        if (!CanAfford(choice)) { SetEventState(InitialDescription, GenerateInitialOptions()); return; }
        Resolved = true; // Claim before awaited commands, across all options on this event instance.
        var player = Owner ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Event has no owner.");
        var cost = choice.GetProperty("cost"); var reward = choice.GetProperty("reward");
        if (cost.GetProperty("gold").GetInt32() is > 0 and var goldCost) await PlayerCmd.LoseGold(goldCost, player, GoldLossType.Spent);
        if (cost.GetProperty("hp").GetInt32() is > 0 and var hpCost)
            await CreatureCmd.Damage(new BlockingPlayerChoiceContext(), player.Creature, hpCost, ValueProp.Unpowered | ValueProp.Unblockable, null, null);
        if (reward.GetProperty("gold").GetInt32() is > 0 and var gold) await PlayerCmd.GainGold(gold, player);
        if (reward.GetProperty("heal").GetInt32() is > 0 and var heal) await CreatureCmd.Heal(player.Creature, heal);
        SetEventFinished(PageDescription("RESULT_" + choice.GetProperty("id").GetString()));
    }
}
